catalog.constitutive_family: unimodal Mualem-van Genuchten using KSATFIT with KSATEXM disabled

holdout_independence.failure_policy: Any failure is fail-closed. Do not change N, storage type, mapping, thresholds or interpolation using holdout observations.

probes_per_material.state_space_definition: Sobol points uniformly mapped into material-specific [S_min,S_max]^2
probes_per_material.coordinate_space_definition: Sobol points uniformly mapped into [0,4]^2 then transformed by h=-10^u and S(h)
probes_per_material.near_hydrostatic_definition: 64 log-spaced upper heads with lower head h_below=h_above+10+epsilon for epsilon in {-0.25,+0.25} cm

aggregate_decision_rule: PASS only if all 36 materials pass every frozen per-material criterion. Any single failure rejects catalog qualification fail-closed.
scope_guard: Even a PASS qualifies only homogeneous unsaturated 10-cm faces in the frozen h=[-10000,-1] cm unimodal MvG KSATFIT catalog. It does not qualify KSATEXM, saturation switching, heterogeneous faces, transient timestep accuracy, other SWAP processes, bottom boundaries, groundwater coupling, MultiSWAP execution, response tangents or FullRichards equivalence.
